_description: The gate discipline as data. scripts/trace-report.mjs reads this instead of hardcoding stage names; the analyser names no stage. Editing THIS file is how the discipline changes. Docs: .cursor/brain/VERIFICATION.md.
_phaseMeaning: The web siblings gate a scaffold phase that skips build/e2e until the first deploy. MEASURED here 2026-08-30: the whole gate is 8.7s (coverage 4.2 · lint 2.1 · tsc 1.2 · format 0.5 · oxlint 0.4 · script tests 0.2 · hooks 0.05) — there is no build, no e2e and no size stage to skip, so a phase switch would be machinery gating nothing. Recorded as a decision, not an omission; revisit if a native build or a Maestro run ever enters the gate.

verify.description: hooks -> oxlint -> format -> tsc -> eslint -> script tests -> coverage

test:one.description: one jest test file, through the tracer

docs:check.description: mechanical doc drift: paths, scripts, sentinels, versions, command table, dead docs; the push budget vs traced pushes of the same phase (report only)

docs._description: Data for scripts/docs-check.mjs. sentinels = verbatim fragments of the tier law that may live only in AGENTS.md; versions = doc names -> package names compared with package-lock.json (node -> .nvmrc).
sentinels: never shortened by what the diff touched
Legal at any time, in any lane, never a violation
Parallel lanes never run heavy stages
A skipped stage is printed, never silent

suites._description: Ceilings on the device suite. It is counted in INVARIANTS, not screens (AGENTS.md § the gate): a route earns a Maestro flow only when it brings an invariant the existing specs do not measure. A suite over its ceiling is a finding, and so is a ceiling more than twice the measurement — that high it flags nothing. Raise a number on a measurement plus a DECISIONS.md line, like a size budget.

commit.description: Husky pre-commit: staged autofix, TDD sibling gate, repo-wide checks. Those run as direct commands, not traced npm scripts, so this moment is declared for completeness.

push.description: Husky pre-push -> verify:ci. Runs unconditionally, never shortened by what the diff touched.
push._budgetMeasured: 2026-09-13, p90 from .gate-trace.log: phase 0 20s ceiling, phase 1 20s ceiling, phase full 20s ceiling
